name: mr-company-formation
description: Prepare a source-based Mauritania research file for entity choice and APIM registration dossier preparation in the 2026 country pack. Use this Guide to identify the taxpayer, classify the transaction, assemble the relevant documents and compare the cited statutory baseline with later amendments. It covers the stated ordinary cases, computation conditions, filing obligations and worked decisions, with official source links and explicit limits. Trigger phrases include Mauritania tax, DGI, taxpayer registration, taxable base, payment deadline and compliance evidence. This is a partial research draft: the complete operative amendment chain and current submission procedures are not established, and no licensed accountant has attested this revision.
